## Study selection

```{r}
#| label: prisma-exclusions
prisma_files <- tar_read(prisma_flow)
excl_tbl <- read.csv(grep("prisma_exclusions", prisma_files, value = TRUE), check.names = FALSE)
```

Records came from Ovid MEDLINE, PubMed, Embase and CENTRAL (3,836 records; searches exported on 19 and 20 October 2026) and from hand-searching the inclusion lists of recent reviews and guidelines (7 further records). After 1,038 duplicates were removed, 2,798 records were screened by title and abstract in a single AI-assisted pass (a second screener is pending) and 2,663 were excluded. Of the 105 reports sought for full-text assessment, 55 were not retrieved (39 had no document to retrieve, such as registry entries and conference abstracts; 14 were sought but not obtained; 2 PDFs were the wrong paper) and 50 were assessed. The review includes 38 reports of 18 studies (7 in the primary set, 11 in the sensitivity set); `{r} sum(excl_tbl$Reports)` reports of `{r} sum(excl_tbl$Studies)` studies were excluded at full text ([reasons below](#tbl-exclusions)), and one ongoing trial awaits results. ClinicalTrials.gov and the WHO ICTRP were not searched directly, and the Ovid MEDLINE primary set was not exported; both are listed on the [Limitations](limitations.qmd) page. The diagram is a draft: counts for records not yet classified may change.

```{r}
#| label: fig-prisma

include_graphics(grep("\\.png$", prisma_files, value = TRUE))
```


## Fit inventory

```{r}
#| label: tbl-inventory
inv <- tibble(
  Fit = c("F1", "F2", "F3", "F4"),
  Definition = c("Primary short-term: severe-CAP set; REMAP-CAP enters through its ICU-discharge contrast (D2a)",
                 "90-day mortality: CAPE COD, APROCCHSS CAP subgroup, REMAP-CAP day-90 contrast",
                 "Broad-severe: F1 plus published severe subgroups of all-hospitalised trials",
                 "All-hospitalised CAP: F1 plus whole-trial rows of the sensitivity set"),
  col = c("fit_primary_short", "fit_primary_d90", "fit_broad_severe", "fit_all_hospitalised")) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(Rows = sum(mortality[[col]] == 1), Trials = n_distinct(mortality$trial_id[mortality[[col]] == 1])) |>
  ungroup() |> select(-col)
kable(inv)
```

## Model and sampling

* **Model.** One-stage random-effects model on the log-OR with a hybrid likelihood: exact binomial for count trials and a normal likelihood for REMAP-CAP, which enters only as an adjusted contrast. Under decision D2a (30 October 2026, extended to F3 and F4 on 10 November) the short-term sets F1, F3 and F4 use its ICU-discharge contrast (log-OR 0.399, SE 0.487), the earliest adjusted mortality contrast it reports, and the 90-day set F2 uses its day-90 pooled contrast (log-OR 0.445, SE 0.362). Both SEs are frozen approximations derived from the published 95% credible intervals (lead decision, 10 November 2026; any investigator-supplied values would be a sensitivity analysis); F1 is refitted with each SE varied (ICU discharge 0.40 and 0.60; day 90 0.30 and 0.45). Trial baselines are unpooled fixed effects with an N(0, 10) prior. Implemented in Stan (`stan/hybrid_ma.stan`) via `cmdstanr`; the protocol text names `brms`, so this is a documented deviation.
* **Fits.** F1 primary short-term (7 trials), F2 90-day (3), F3 broad-severe (10), F4 all-hospitalised (17); F1 with an agent hierarchy; prior ladder; tipping-point analyses; sensitivity fits; meta-regressions.
* **Sampling.** 4 chains × 2000 post-warmup draws, `adapt_delta` 0.99 (raised automatically to 0.999, then 0.9999, if a fit has divergences; the [convergence page](convergence.qmd) lists any fit that needed this), `max_treedepth` 12, seed 7291. A fit is accepted only if R-hat < 1.01, bulk and tail ESS > 400 and there are zero divergences.
* **Priors.** Pooled log-OR μ: Normal(0, 1) in the main fits (the reference rung), with the alternatives on the [prior ladder page](priors.qmd); between-trial SD τ ~ half-Normal(0, 0.5); between-agent SD ω ~ half-Normal(0, 0.25); trial baselines Normal(0, 10). The sensitivity page varies τ, ω and the baseline prior.
* **Quantities.** Posterior median OR with a 95% quantile credible interval (CrI; HDI columns are in the downloadable tables), P(OR<1), P(OR<0.9), P(OR<0.833), P(OR>1.1), τ, the predictive OR for a new trial, and the absolute risk reduction (ARR) and number needed to treat (NNT). OR < 0.833 (= 1/1.2) is an odds ratio for survival of at least 1.2, that is a reduction of about 17% in the odds of death; it is the threshold REMAP-CAP used in its futility rule.

## Risk of bias

Risk of bias was assessed with the Cochrane RoB 2 tool for all-cause mortality at each trial's primary-analysis timepoint (effect of assignment), across the five RoB 2 domains, with the overall rating derived by the RoB 2 rule. For subgroup-derived trials, domain 5 also records whether the subgroup was pre-specified. The seven primary-set trials were rated independently by two assessors (assessor 1, an AI-generated draft from the extracted signalling information; assessor 2, a human reviewer working from the full texts and signalling questions). Disagreements were listed in a reconciliation sheet with a proposal for each, and the consensus was recorded by the project lead adopting those proposals on 4 November and amended on 10 November to adopt the second assessor's judgements where they differed, so it now equals the second assessor's ratings. Sensitivity-set trials have only the assessor-1 draft. The ratings feed the low-risk-of-bias sensitivity analysis (S-ii), which is run for each assessor and for the consensus. Details, agreement and the consensus rationale are on the [risk of bias page](risk_of_bias.qmd).

## Abbreviations

CrI: credible interval; OR: odds ratio; RR: risk ratio; ARR: absolute risk reduction; NNT: number needed to treat; ESS: effective sample size; ELPD: expected log predictive density; IPD: individual patient data; RoB 2: Cochrane risk-of-bias tool, version 2; PSI: Pneumonia Severity Index.
